root_cause_diagnosis: Stock breaks ORB but encounters major daily 200 SMA / multi-month swing high within <1.0R runway.
proposed_failure_risk_veto: Add Minimum Overhead Runway Gate: Entry must have >= 1.5R clearance to major daily resistance.

root_cause_diagnosis: Nifty 50/Bank Nifty opens strong then breaks below VWAP within first 45 mins.
proposed_failure_risk_veto: Add Index VWAP Filter: Halt new Gem triggers if Nifty breaks below VWAP with declining slope.

root_cause_diagnosis: Single massive 5-minute opening candle absorbs all day liquidity (>400% RVOL), stalling immediately.
proposed_failure_risk_veto: Add Volume Climax Cap: Reject setups where Candle 1 RVOL > 6.0x with spinning top / doji.

root_cause_diagnosis: Stock breaks out while its sector index is red / lagging.
proposed_failure_risk_veto: Add Sector Relative Strength Filter: Sector index must be in top 50th percentile of morning market breadth.

root_cause_diagnosis: Stock gaps up >4.5% at open, creating immediate profit-taking sell-side pressure.
proposed_failure_risk_veto: Add Maximum Gap Threshold: Cap eligible open gap to <= 3.5% above previous close.
